name: ScreenTester5
description: Screen tester: solid colours and test patterns to find dead or stuck pixels, check uniformity and geometry, and run stuck-pixel recovery.
author: Marice
release_notes:
First native PS5 title release (homebrew.page catalog format). Tags now follow the contentVersion in sce_sys/param.json.

Added
- Native PS5 title build (title ID PPSA69420) with the ps5-native-app-boilerplate tooling: signed eboot.bin, sce_sys, libc.prx, ready for ShadowMountPlus and the homebrew.page catalog.
- The version number is shown in the control overlay.
- LICENSE (GPL-3.0-or-later) and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

Changed
- Drawing goes into a 1080p framebuffer shown through libSceVideoOut; SDL2 is only used for the controller. Static screens are drawn once.
- Own mmap-based heap for the title sandbox (shared with OliSe Player).

Removed
- The websrv/elfldr payload build, the debug PKG source target and the L2 + R2 quit combination; close the app with the PS button.

Install: unzip PPSA69420.zip and copy the PPSA69420 folder to /data/homebrew/ (ShadowMountPlus).
